entries.en: The conservator laid the araneum lace on dark cloth so that its openwork pattern was easier to see.
entries.zh: 文物保护员把阿拉尼姆抽花蕾丝铺在深色布上，以便更清楚地看见其镂空纹样。

entries.meaningZh: 阿拉诺丁；一种真菌产生的含硫次级代谢产物（aranotin）
entries.en: The fungal culture yielded aranotin, a sulfur-containing secondary metabolite.
entries.zh: 这份真菌培养物产生了阿拉诺丁，一种含硫的次级代谢产物。

entries.meaningZh: 磁玄岩；富含磁铁矿的玄武质岩石
entries.en: The geologist identified the magnetite-rich rock as arapahite after examining a thin section.
entries.zh: 地质学家检查了岩石薄片后，将这块富含磁铁矿的岩石鉴定为磁玄岩。

entries.meaningZh: 阿拉帕霍语；阿拉巴霍语
entries.en: The children practiced counting aloud in Arapaho.
entries.zh: 孩子们练习用阿拉帕霍语大声数数。

entries.meaningZh: 无缝的；没有缝合线的
entries.en: She turned the araphorostic tunic inside out, looking in vain for a seam.
entries.zh: 她把那件无缝长袍翻过来，却怎么也找不到缝合线。

entries.meaningZh: 中裂豆木；一种巴西乔木（arariba，Centrolobium robustum）
entries.en: The cabinetmaker chose arariba for the drawer fronts so the wood's markings would be easy to see.
entries.zh: 细木工选择中裂豆木制作抽屉面板，以便清楚展示木材的纹理。

entries.meaningZh: 五加皂苷元（旧称；早期文献报告的三萜皂苷元）
entries.en: The thesis lists arasapogenin among sapogenins whose structures were still unknown at the time.
entries.zh: 这篇学位论文把五加皂苷元列在当时结构仍未确定的皂苷元之中。

entries.meaningZh: 阿劳卡尼亚人（复数，南美原住民族群的历史称呼）
entries.en: In the historical novel, two Araucanians disagree about whether to join the expedition.
entries.zh: 在这部历史小说中，两位阿劳卡尼亚人就是否参加探险队产生了分歧。

entries.meaningZh: 南洋杉科（Araucariaceae，不是南美杉科）
entries.en: The botanist placed the specimen in the araucaria family rather than the pine family.
entries.zh: 植物学家将标本归入南洋杉科，而不是松科。

entries.meaningZh: 南洋杉属的；属于或关于南洋杉属植物的
entries.en: The fossil collection contains several araucarian cones from the same rock layer.
entries.zh: 这批化石藏品中有几枚出自同一岩层的南洋杉属植物球果。

entries.meaningZh: 阿拉瓦克人（复数，南美洲的一支原住民族群的成员）
entries.en: The historian interviewed Arawaks as well as researchers who had studied their language.
entries.zh: 这位历史学者既采访了阿拉瓦克人，也采访了研究过他们语言的学者。

entries.meaningZh: 海胆精子中提取的一种类组蛋白物质（历史名称 arbacin）
entries.en: The researcher compared arbacin from sea-urchin sperm with histones from other animals.
entries.zh: 研究人员将海胆精子中提取的arbacin与其他动物的组蛋白作了比较。

entries.meaningZh: 阿拉伯醇（原研究表中作 arbaitol）
entries.en: The analyst checked the peak labelled arbaitol against the reference standard for arabitol.
entries.zh: 分析员把标为arbaitol（阿拉伯醇）的峰与阿拉伯醇参照标准品作了比对。

entries.meaningZh: 中世纪劲弩
entries.en: The museum reconstruction showed how an arbalist was drawn before firing.
entries.zh: 博物馆的复原展示说明了中世纪劲弩在发射前如何上弦。

entries.meaningZh: 劲弩手；使用中世纪劲弩的人
entries.en: The arbalister in the historical novel waited behind the shield while his weapon was reloaded.
entries.zh: 历史小说中的劲弩手在盾牌后等候，直到武器重新装填完毕。

entries.meaningZh: 工作；劳动（德语词 Arbeit，名词）
entries.en: The German teacher wrote Arbeit on the board before discussing words for different kinds of work.
entries.zh: 德语老师先在黑板上写下Arbeit，再讲解表示不同工作种类的词语。

entries.meaningZh: Arbitron公司；一家媒体受众调查公司，2013年被Nielsen收购
entries.en: The station's 2012 report cited audience figures supplied by Arbitron.
entries.zh: 这家电台的2012年报告引用了Arbitron公司提供的受众数据。

entries.meaningZh: 在树上生活或活动地；以树栖方式
entries.en: The study compared mammals that forage arboreally with those that search on the ground.
entries.zh: 研究比较了在树上觅食的哺乳动物与在地面寻找食物的哺乳动物。

entries.meaningZh: 两旁植树的；有树木遮蔽或设有凉亭的
entries.en: An arbored path led from the terrace to the pond.
entries.zh: 一条两旁植树的小径从露台通向池塘。

entries.meaningZh: 树状的；形似树木的
entries.en: The frost formed an arboresque pattern across the window.
entries.zh: 霜在窗上形成了一幅树状图案。

entries.meaningZh: 树木的；与树有关的（罕见用语）
entries.en: The critic linked the poem's arborical imagery to the author's childhood orchard.
entries.zh: 评论者把诗中的树木意象与作者童年的果园联系起来。

entries.meaningZh: 杀树剂；用于杀死树木的除草剂（复数）
entries.en: The forestry crew compared two arboricides for controlling the invasive saplings.
entries.zh: 林业作业队比较了两种用于控制入侵树种幼树的杀树剂。

entries.meaningZh: 荫度；将图的边划分为若干森林所需的最少森林数（图论）
entries.en: A cycle has arboricity two because its edges cannot all belong to a single forest.
entries.zh: 一个环的荫度为二，因为它的所有边不可能都属于同一个森林。

entries.meaningZh: 山小橘碱；一种喹唑啉酮类生物碱（arborine）
entries.en: Arborine was one of the alkaloids recovered from the Glycosmis extract.
entries.zh: 山小橘碱是从山小橘属植物提取物中分离得到的生物碱之一。

entries.meaningZh: 形成树枝状分支；反复分枝（英国拼写）
entries.en: The diagram shows how the nerve fibres arborise near their endings.
entries.zh: 图示说明了神经纤维如何在末端附近反复分枝。

entries.meaningZh: 树木崇拜；把树木作为崇拜对象的宗教习俗
entries.en: The shrine's rituals centred on arborolatry, and offerings were placed before the old tree.
entries.zh: 这座神殿的仪式以树木崇拜为中心，人们在那棵古树前摆放祭品。

entries.meaningZh: 虫媒病毒（arbovirus 的非正式复数简称）
entries.en: The virologist separated confirmed arbos from viruses whose transmission route was still uncertain.
entries.zh: 病毒学家把已确认的虫媒病毒与传播途径仍不确定的病毒分开列出。

entries.meaningZh: 矮树；树状灌木（罕见用语）
entries.en: A wind-bent arbuscle grew out of a crack in the rock.
entries.zh: 一棵被风吹弯的矮树从岩石裂缝中长出。

entries.meaningZh: 丛枝状结构的；与丛枝有关的（本例为菌根术语）
entries.en: The microscope revealed arbuscular structures inside the colonised root cells.
entries.zh: 显微镜显示，受到定殖的根细胞内有丛枝状结构。

entries.meaningZh: 丛枝；菌根真菌形成的树枝状吸收结构（复数）
entries.en: The student counted the arbuscules visible in one stained section of the root.
entries.zh: 学生数了数一片染色根切片中可见的丛枝。

entries.meaningZh: 熊果苷酶；能水解熊果苷的酶（旧称）
entries.en: In the demonstration, arbutase broke down arbutin into glucose and hydroquinone.
entries.zh: 在演示中，熊果苷酶将熊果苷分解成葡萄糖和氢醌。

entries.meaningZh: 草莓树属乔木（旧称，不是杨梅属）
entries.en: In the old garden narrative, an arbute shades the stone seat.
entries.zh: 在那篇旧时园林叙事中，一棵草莓树为石椅遮阴。

entries.meaningZh: 蚶属；一种海生双壳类动物的属（学名 Arca）
entries.en: She compared the hinges of two species in the genus Arca.
entries.zh: 她比较了蚶属两个物种的壳铰合部。

entries.meaningZh: 掌握制造秘方的工匠（尤指制瓷）
entries.en: The arcanist refused to reveal the mixture used to make the porcelain body.
entries.zh: 那位掌握秘方的制瓷工匠拒绝透露瓷胎的配料。

entries.meaningZh: 钾芒硝；天然硫酸钾矿物
entries.en: The mineralogist distinguished arcanite from the other sulphates in the crust.
entries.zh: 矿物学家把结壳中的钾芒硝与其他硫酸盐区分开来。

entries.meaningZh: 灭弧器；用于抑制电弧的装置
entries.en: A cracked insulating plate was removed from the arc-arrester before the controller was put back into service.
entries.zh: 控制器重新投入使用前，工作人员取下了灭弧器上一块开裂的绝缘板。

entries.meaningZh: Arcatron；一种历史上的冷阴极电子管型号名
entries.en: The display paired an Arcatron cold-cathode tube with a period circuit diagram.
entries.zh: 展览把一只Arcatron冷阴极管与一张同时代的电路图放在一起展示。

entries.meaningZh: 角度单位“度”；圆周的三百六十分之一
entries.en: The telescope's field of view was slightly wider than one arcdegree.
entries.zh: 这架望远镜的视场略大于一度。

entries.meaningZh: 考古天文学家
entries.en: The archaeoastronomer measured the doorway's alignment before discussing its possible relation to sunrise.
entries.zh: 考古天文学家先测量了门道的朝向，才讨论它与日出可能存在的关系。

entries.meaningZh: 考古天文学家（复数）
entries.en: Two archaeoastronomers disagreed about whether the alignment was deliberate.
entries.zh: 两位考古天文学家对那种朝向是否出于有意设计持不同看法。

entries.meaningZh: 考古植物学家
entries.en: The archaeobotanist recovered charred seeds from the ancient hearth.
entries.zh: 考古植物学家从古代炉灶中取出了炭化种子。

entries.meaningZh: 研究最古老地质时期的地质学；古地质学
entries.en: Her course in archaeogeology began with rocks that preserve traces of the early Earth.
entries.zh: 她的古地质学课程从保留着早期地球痕迹的岩石讲起。

entries.meaningZh: 考古学的
entries.en: The team recorded the archaeologic context of each fragment before moving it.
entries.zh: 团队在移动每块碎片前，都记录了它的考古背景。

entries.meaningZh: 古鸟（archaeornis，一种具齿、翼爪和长羽尾的已灭绝原始鸟类）
entries.en: The artist's archaeornis had teeth, wing claws and a long feathered tail.
entries.zh: 画家笔下的古鸟长着牙齿、带爪的翼指和一条覆羽的长尾。

entries.meaningZh: 本原生命力；帕拉塞尔苏斯学派认为支配生物的生命力量
entries.en: The lecturer described the archaeus as a governing force in Paracelsian explanations of life.
entries.zh: 讲者将本原生命力描述为帕拉塞尔苏斯学派解释生命时所说的一种支配力量。

entries.meaningZh: 太古的；属于最古老地质时期的（历史拼法 archaian）
entries.en: The old geological map marked the exposed gneiss as archaian.
entries.zh: 那幅旧地质图把露出的片麻岩标为太古岩层。

entries.meaningZh: 初胚变异；胚胎发育在早期偏离祖先发育模式而不再重演该模式（历史生物学用语）
entries.en: The lecturer used archallaxis to describe an early divergence from an ancestral pattern of embryonic development.
entries.zh: 讲师用“初胚变异”描述胚胎发育早期对祖先发育模式的偏离。

entries.meaningZh: 早期人类；旧分类中称直立人等为“猿人”的类别成员
entries.en: The historian explained why the old classification called Homo erectus an archanthropine.
entries.zh: 历史学家解释了旧分类为何把直立人称为“猿人”（archanthropine）。

entries.meaningZh: 会吏长职位；会吏长任期
entries.en: The church history devotes a chapter to her long archdeaconship.
entries.zh: 那部教会史用一章讲述了她长期担任会吏长的经历。

entries.meaningZh: 大公国；大公统治的领地
entries.en: The map placed the fictional archdukedom between two rival kingdoms.
entries.zh: 地图把那个虚构的大公国画在两个敌对王国之间。

entries.meaningZh: 大体保持原型的；与原始类型相符的（生物学）
entries.en: The new specimens were archecentric in overall form despite their unusual colour.
entries.zh: 这些新标本虽然颜色异常，整体形态却大体保持了原型。

entries.meaningZh: 原脉网；某些原始或化石昆虫翅上位于主脉间的网状隆脊结构
entries.en: The fossil wing preserved an archedictyon between its larger veins.
entries.zh: 这片化石翅在较大的翅脉之间保存了原脉网。

entries.meaningZh: 颈卵器；藏卵器（archegonium 的复数）
entries.en: The students located the archegonia on the fern gametophyte.
entries.zh: 学生们在蕨类植物的配子体上找到了颈卵器。

entries.meaningZh: 颈卵器植物；能产生颈卵器的植物
entries.en: The old textbook used a fern as its example of an archegoniate.
entries.zh: 那本旧课本用一株蕨类植物作为颈卵器植物的例子。

entries.meaningZh: 颈卵器托
entries.en: She sketched the stalk of the archegoniophore before drawing the structures it supported.
entries.zh: 她先画了颈卵器托的柄，再画它所承托的结构。

entries.meaningZh: 海绵动物的原细胞；能分化为其他细胞的变形细胞
entries.en: An archeocyte can develop into a different kind of cell within a sponge.
entries.zh: 海绵动物体内的原细胞能够分化为另一种细胞。

entries.meaningZh: 古文献学；研究古代文献的描述、整理及出版方法的辅助历史学科
entries.en: Her training in archeography helped her prepare the monastery's handwritten records for publication.
entries.zh: 她所受的古文献学训练帮助她整理修道院的手写档案，以供出版。

entries.meaningZh: 从考古学角度；在考古学上
entries.en: The hill was archeologically important even though no buildings remained above ground.
entries.zh: 尽管地面上已没有建筑遗存，那座山丘在考古学上仍很重要。

entries.meaningZh: 孢原细胞或孢原组织；孢子发生组织的原始细胞或细胞群
entries.en: The archespore gave rise to the tissue in which spores later formed.
entries.zh: 孢原细胞产生了后来形成孢子的组织。

entries.meaningZh: 典型地；作为某种典型原型地
entries.en: The film's wandering hero is archetypally a seeker, always leaving comfort behind.
entries.zh: 电影中四处漂泊的主人公是典型的求索者，总会离开安逸的生活。

entries.meaningZh: 原环虫类；环节动物旧分类中的一个类群（Archiannelida）
entries.en: The chapter on Archiannelida described tiny worms without obvious external segmentation.
entries.zh: 关于原环虫类的那一章描述了一些外部没有明显分节的微小蠕虫。

entries.meaningZh: 御医；宫廷首席医师（历史用语）
entries.en: In the historical drama, the archiater is summoned to the emperor's bedside.
entries.zh: 在那部历史剧中，御医被召到皇帝床前。

entries.meaningZh: 原胚；旧胚胎学中对生发泡周围颗粒状区域的称呼
entries.en: The old diagram places the archiblast around the germinal vesicle.
entries.zh: 这幅旧图将原胚标在生发泡周围。

entries.meaningZh: 古小脑（与前庭平衡感觉有关的小脑部分）
entries.en: The lecturer highlighted the archicerebellum while explaining the brain's role in balance.
entries.zh: 讲师在解释脑对平衡的作用时，特别标出了古小脑。

entries.meaningZh: 原体腔；旧动物学中指发育时消化道与外胚层之间的初始腔隙
entries.en: The diagram shows the archicoel as a space between the early gut and the outer cell layer.
entries.zh: 图中将原体腔画成早期消化道与外层细胞之间的空隙。

entries.meaningZh: 古陆核；在可记录的地质时期中持续存在的大陆核心
entries.en: On the reconstruction, younger belts of rock surround the archicontinent.
entries.zh: 在这幅复原图上，较年轻的岩带环绕着古陆核。

entries.meaningZh: 原皮质；以海马结构为代表的三层大脑皮质
entries.en: The lecture contrasted the three-layered archicortex with the six-layered neocortex.
entries.zh: 讲座对比了三层结构的原皮质与六层结构的新皮质。

entries.meaningZh: 大主教制；由大主教掌握主要权力的教会体制
entries.en: The historian contrasted archiepiscopacy with systems that gave local congregations more authority.
entries.zh: 历史学者把大主教制与赋予地方教众更多权力的体制作了对比。

entries.meaningZh: 由大主教或以大主教职权地
entries.en: The school could open only after its statutes had been archiepiscopally approved.
entries.zh: 这所学校只有在其章程获得大主教核准后才能开办。

entries.meaningZh: 某些无脊椎动物幼体的原始排泄器官（通常为管细胞式）
entries.en: The archinephridium helped remove wastes from the tiny invertebrate larva.
entries.zh: 那只微小的无脊椎动物幼体借助原始排泄器官排出废物。

entries.meaningZh: 神经活动的起始神经元（旧术语）
entries.en: In the older model, the impulse began in the archineuron before reaching the next neuron.
entries.zh: 在这一旧模型中，冲动先起始于起始神经元，然后传至下一个神经元。

entries.meaningZh: archiplasm；旧细胞学中被认为构成纺锤丝和星射线的物质
entries.en: The old theory treated spindle fibres as condensations of a substance called archiplasm.
entries.zh: 这套旧理论把纺锤丝视为一种名叫archiplasm的物质凝聚而成的结构。

entries.meaningZh: 从建筑结构或组织构造上看
entries.en: Architectonically, the library connects three separate courtyards through one central hall.
entries.zh: 从建筑结构上看，这座图书馆通过一个中央大厅连接了三个独立庭院。

entries.meaningZh: 大王乌贼属（学名 Architeuthis）
entries.en: The team compared Architeuthis with other squid genera in its evolutionary analysis.
entries.zh: 研究团队在演化分析中将大王乌贼属与其他乌贼类群的属进行了比较。

entries.meaningZh: 归档；档案整理保存的过程
entries.en: The exhibition follows a century of archivism, from bound registers to searchable digital records.
entries.zh: 这场展览展示了一个世纪的档案整理保存历程，从装订成册的登记簿到可检索的数字记录。

entries.meaningZh: 大鲁特琴（低音乐器，非弓形竖琴）
entries.en: The musician tuned the archlute before the singers entered.
entries.zh: 歌手们进场前，乐师给大鲁特琴调好了音。

entries.meaningZh: 脊柱曲度测量器（一些研究中作 archometer，亦写 arcometer）
entries.en: The physiotherapist recorded a thoracic-curvature measurement with the archometer.
entries.zh: 物理治疗师用脊柱曲度测量器记录了一次胸椎曲度测量值。

entries.meaningZh: 主龙类的；与主龙类有关的
entries.en: The palaeontologist compared archosaurian ankle bones from several fossil sites.
entries.zh: 古生物学家比较了几个化石遗址出土的主龙类踝骨。

entries.meaningZh: 圆弧规；无需利用圆心即可绘制圆弧的仪器
entries.en: An arcograph let the drafter draw the broad curve even though its center lay beyond the edge of the sheet.
entries.zh: 尽管圆心落在图纸边缘以外，制图员仍能借助圆弧规画出那段大圆弧。

entries.meaningZh: 巨型生态建筑城；把城市容纳于单一结构中的建筑体（复数）
entries.en: The science-fiction novel imagines arcologies rising above a flooded plain.
entries.zh: 那部科幻小说想象了矗立在淹水平原上的巨型生态建筑城。

entries.meaningZh: 电弧稳定性记录仪；记录焊接电弧稳定性的历史仪器
entries.en: The engineer used an arconograph to record fluctuations in the welding arc.
entries.zh: 工程师使用电弧稳定性记录仪记录焊接电弧的波动。

entries.meaningZh: 电弧摆动器；焊接中控制电弧摆动的装置
entries.en: The arc oscillator swept the welding torch from side to side along the joint.
entries.zh: 电弧摆动器使焊枪沿接缝左右摆动。

entries.meaningZh: 长石砂岩（arkose 的另一拼法）
entries.en: Pink grains of feldspar stood out in the freshly broken arcose.
entries.zh: 新敲开的长石砂岩中，粉红色的长石颗粒格外醒目。

entries.meaningZh: 电弧放电开关管（此处指20世纪60年代的 arcotron）
entries.en: The designer used an arcotron to switch the current in the experimental circuit.
entries.zh: 设计师用一只电弧放电开关管来切换实验电路中的电流。

entries.meaningZh: 飞弧；闪络；电弧越过绝缘间隙形成的放电
entries.en: A sudden arc-over damaged the insulation near the terminal.
entries.zh: 一次突发的飞弧损坏了端子附近的绝缘材料。

entries.meaningZh: 北极蛤属（学名 Arctica）
entries.en: An entire drawer was devoted to shells from the genus Arctica.
entries.zh: 整整一个抽屉都用来存放北极蛤属的贝壳。

entries.meaningZh: 冰冷地；极冷地（罕用，可作比喻）
entries.en: She smiled arctically and closed the door before he could explain.
entries.zh: 她冷冰冰地笑了笑，没等他解释就关上了门。

entries.meaningZh: 极寒适应改装；使设备适合极地严寒条件的准备
entries.en: Arcticization of the research vehicle included extra insulation around its battery compartment.
entries.zh: 这辆科研车的极寒适应改装包括在电池舱周围加装保温层。

entries.meaningZh: 使适应极地严寒条件（arcticize 的过去式）
entries.en: Before the winter trial, the mechanics arcticized the generator for service at the polar station.
entries.zh: 冬季试验前，机械师对发电机作了极寒适应改装，以便在极地站使用。

entries.meaningZh: 北极陆地的（旧动物地理用法）
entries.en: The naturalist's notebook contrasted arctogeal fauna with animals of equatorial forests.
entries.zh: 这位博物学家的笔记将北极陆地动物群与赤道森林动物进行了对比。

entries.meaningZh: 弓形弯曲；拱曲
entries.en: The drawing exaggerated the arcuation of the bridge's central span.
entries.zh: 那幅画夸大了桥梁主跨的弓形弯曲。

entries.meaningZh: ardealite矿物；含磷酸氢根和硫酸根的水合钙矿物
entries.en: Pale yellow crusts of ardealite coated part of the limestone cave wall.
entries.zh: 淡黄色的ardealite矿物薄壳覆盖着石灰岩洞壁的一部分。

entries.meaningZh: 热情；热烈
entries.en: The ardentness of her plea moved even the most sceptical listeners.
entries.zh: 她恳求时的热切打动了最持怀疑态度的听众。

entries.meaningZh: 丝光沸石（mordenite）的旧称，旧称 arduinite
entries.en: The old label said arduinite, but the mineral is catalogued today as mordenite.
entries.zh: 旧标签写的是arduinite，而这种矿物如今以“丝光沸石”编目。

entries.meaningZh: 按面积；就面积而言
entries.en: The smallest district was also the most densely populated areally.
entries.zh: 面积最小的地区，按面积计算的人口密度也最高。

entries.meaningZh: 纤维细度气流测定仪；通过纤维对气流的阻力评估细度和形状的仪器
entries.en: The arealometer compared cotton samples by measuring their resistance to airflow.
entries.zh: 纤维细度气流测定仪通过测量棉纤维样品对气流的阻力来比较这些样品。

entries.meaningZh: 槟榔次碱；水解槟榔碱（arecaidine，一种槟榔生物碱）
entries.en: The analysis distinguished arecaidine from the more abundant alkaloid arecoline.
entries.zh: 这项分析区分了槟榔次碱与含量更高的另一种生物碱槟榔碱。

entries.meaningZh: 解释；解读（古语，aread 的另一拼法）
entries.en: In the tale, the hermit tries to areed the queen's troubling dream.
entries.zh: 在这个故事里，隐士试图解读王后那令人不安的梦。

entries.meaningZh: 干燥；脱水干燥的过程或状态（旧用）
entries.en: Prolonged arefaction left the leaves brittle and easily crumbled.
entries.zh: 长时间的干燥使叶片变脆，很容易碎裂。

entries.meaningZh: 沙海；沙丘覆盖的沙漠地区（erg 的复数）
entries.en: The expedition crossed two areg before reaching the stony plateau.
entries.zh: 考察队穿过两片沙海，才到达多石的高原。

entries.meaningZh: 阿雷亚（Areia，巴西帕拉伊巴州的一个市镇）
entries.en: The students stayed in Areia, in Brazil's Paraíba state, while visiting nearby farms.
entries.zh: 学生们在参观附近农场期间，住在巴西帕拉伊巴州的阿雷亚。

entries.meaningZh: 桄榔属（棕榈科植物属）
entries.en: The greenhouse devoted one bench to young palms of Arenga.
entries.zh: 温室专门用一个苗床摆放桄榔属的幼小棕榈。

entries.meaningZh: 砂栖石；保存在岩石中的古蠕虫潜穴遗迹
entries.en: What looked like a crack in the slab was actually an arenicolite, the trace of an ancient burrowing worm.
entries.zh: 石板上看似裂缝的痕迹其实是砂栖石，也就是古代钻穴蠕虫留下的遗迹。

entries.meaningZh: 人造石；含硅质、黏土质和钙质成分的人造石材
entries.en: The builder chose arenolite for the imitation-stone panels beside the entrance.
entries.zh: 建筑工选择用这种人造石制作入口旁的仿石饰板。

entries.meaningZh: 砂土；以砂质材料和较弱土层发育为特征的土类（Arenosol）
entries.en: The arenosol beneath the garden drained quickly after the storm.
entries.zh: 暴风雨过后，花园下面的砂土很快排干了水。

entries.meaningZh: 人为深度混合的新成土（Arent，不限于红色砂土）
entries.en: Deep cultivation had mixed the horizons of the arent beyond easy recognition.
entries.zh: 深耕已经把那片人为混合新成土的土层混在一起，使它们难以辨认。

entries.meaningZh: 具有小区或细隙的（解剖组织）
entries.en: In the anatomical drawing, tiny spaces give the connective tissue an areolated appearance.
entries.zh: 在这幅解剖图中，微小的间隙使结缔组织呈现出分隔成小区的外观。

entries.meaningZh: 刺座；仙人掌上生出刺、花或新枝的部位
entries.en: A tiny flower bud emerged from an areole near the top of the cactus.
entries.zh: 一个小花蕾从仙人掌顶部附近的刺座上冒了出来。

entries.meaningZh: 刺座（仙人掌术语，复数）
entries.en: The young cactus had pale wool around its areoles.
entries.zh: 那株幼小的仙人掌的刺座周围有浅色绒毛。

entries.meaningZh: 小网室；昆虫翅脉围成的小室
entries.en: The illustrator enlarged the wing's central areolet so its borders could be seen clearly.
entries.zh: 插画师把翅膀中央的小网室放大，好让人清楚看见它的边界。

entries.meaningZh: 稠液比重计；结合定容试样容器测定半流体等物质比重的仪器
entries.en: The engineer used an areopycnometer to determine the specific gravity of the asphalt sample.
entries.zh: 工程师用稠液比重计测定了那份沥青样品的比重。

entries.meaningZh: 阿雷雷溪（Arerê，巴西塞阿拉州帕卡茹斯地区的溪流名称）
entries.en: The local history traces the early settlement to the banks of the Arerê stream in what is now Pacajus, Brazil.
entries.zh: 这部地方史记述，早期聚落建在阿雷雷溪岸边，位于如今巴西帕卡茹斯所在的地区。

entries.meaningZh: 矛托；骑士冲刺时支承长矛的装置（旧用）
entries.en: The knight's lance rested on the arest as he faced the wooden target.
entries.zh: 骑士面对木制标靶时，长矛搁在矛托上。

entries.meaningZh: 龙口兰属；兰科植物的一个属（学名 Arethusa）
entries.en: The genus Arethusa has just one currently accepted species.
entries.zh: 龙口兰属目前只有一个获接受的物种。

entries.meaningZh: 阿尔冈灯；使用中空管状灯芯的油灯
entries.en: The restored Argand lit the writing desk with a steady flame.
entries.zh: 修复后的阿尔冈灯以稳定的火焰照亮了书桌。

entries.meaningZh: 银胺液；含银与乙二胺的旧消毒制剂
entries.en: The pharmacist's old reference book grouped argentamine with other silver antiseptics.
entries.zh: 药剂师的那本旧参考书把银胺液与其他含银消毒剂归在一起。

entries.meaningZh: 银膜；某些动物眼中的反光层
entries.en: The squid's argentea caught the light as the eye was turned under the microscope.
entries.zh: 在显微镜下转动鱿鱼的眼睛时，其银膜反射出光亮。

entries.meaningZh: 银氰络盐；氰化银与另一氰化物形成的复盐
entries.en: The formula on the label showed that the argentocyanide contained both sodium and silver.
entries.zh: 标签上的化学式表明，这种银氰络盐同时含有钠和银。

entries.meaningZh: 羟基喹啉磺酸银；旧含银消毒制剂名 argentol
entries.en: The lecture compared argentol, an old silver antiseptic, with the silver proteins listed on the next page.
entries.zh: 讲课时，教师把旧含银消毒剂羟基喹啉磺酸银与下一页列出的蛋白银制剂作了比较。

entries.meaningZh: 测银计；测定溶液中银盐含量的仪器
entries.en: Before reusing the photographic bath, the technician checked its silver-salt content with an argentometer.
entries.zh: 再次使用摄影药液前，技术员用测银计检查了其中的银盐含量。

entries.meaningZh: 银量法；使用银化合物进行的定量化学分析
entries.en: The laboratory used argentometry to determine the chloride content of the water.
entries.zh: 实验室采用银量法测定水中的氯化物含量。

entries.meaningZh: 嗜银的（本例用于水生昆虫幼虫中摄取离子的特化细胞）
entries.en: The larva took up ions through argentophilic cells in its anal papillae.
entries.zh: 这只幼虫通过肛乳突中的嗜银细胞摄取离子。

entries.meaningZh: 银染阴性的；不呈银染色反应的（此处指染色体区域）
entries.en: The researcher labelled the unstained centromeric regions argentophobic on the chromosome image.
entries.zh: 研究者在染色体图像上把未显色的着丝粒区域标为“银染阴性”。

entries.meaningZh: 蛋白银；银与蛋白质构成的胶体制剂
entries.en: The old dispensary list placed argentoproteinum among the silver-based antiseptic preparations.
entries.zh: 那份旧药房清单把蛋白银列在含银消毒制剂中。

entries.meaningZh: 核蛋白银；银与核蛋白构成的制剂
entries.en: In the pharmacy catalogue, argentose was described as a silver–nucleoprotein compound.
entries.zh: 在那本药品目录中，核蛋白银被描述为银与核蛋白构成的化合物。

entries.meaningZh: 阿尔甘纤维；pita 植物叶片所得的纺织纤维
entries.en: The craftswoman drew a length of arghan through the leather to stitch the pattern.
entries.zh: 女匠人把一段阿尔甘纤维线穿过皮革，缝出图案。

entries.meaningZh: 具有黏土淀积层或钠质层的旱成土（Argid）
entries.en: The soil scientist examined the argid's clay-rich horizon before classifying the profile.
entries.zh: 土壤学家先检查了那片黏化旱成土的富黏土层，再对整个土壤剖面进行分类。

entries.meaningZh: 阿根廷佬（英式俚语，常带侮辱性）
entries.en: The editor replaced the slur "Argie" with "Argentine" in the caption.
entries.zh: 编辑把图片说明中的侮辱性称呼“阿根廷佬”改成了“阿根廷人”。

entries.meaningZh: 泥化作用；岩石蚀变形成黏土矿物的过程
entries.en: Argillization had replaced much of the original rock with clay minerals.
entries.zh: 泥化作用已使原有岩石的很大一部分被黏土矿物取代。

entries.meaningZh: 精氨基琥珀酸血症；一种由精氨基琥珀酸裂解酶基因缺陷引起的遗传性尿素循环障碍
entries.en: Genetic testing confirmed argininosuccinic acidemia in the child after repeated episodes of high blood ammonia.
entries.zh: 孩子反复出现血氨升高后，基因检测确诊其患有精氨基琥珀酸血症。

entries.meaningZh: 精氨酸尿；精氨酸经尿液排出，尤指异常增多
entries.en: Argininuria increased during the infusion even though blood arginine rose less than expected.
entries.zh: 输注过程中，尽管血液中的精氨酸升高幅度低于预期，尿液中精氨酸的排出量仍有所增加。

entries.meaningZh: 精亮氨素；一种链霉菌代谢产物
entries.en: The laboratory recovered arglecin from a Streptomyces culture filtrate for further chemical analysis.
entries.zh: 实验室从链霉菌培养滤液中分离出精亮氨素，以作进一步化学分析。

entries.meaningZh: 神话中阿尔戈号的；与阿尔戈号有关的
entries.en: The set designer painted the Argoan oars bright red for the school play.
entries.zh: 舞台布景设计者为学校戏剧把阿尔戈号的桨漆成了鲜红色。

entries.meaningZh: 银蓝素；亚甲蓝银染料（旧制剂名）
entries.en: The conservator photographed the argochrome bottle among the collection's microscopy dyes.
entries.zh: 文物保护员拍摄了馆藏显微染料中的那瓶银蓝素。

entries.meaningZh: 阿尔戈利斯的；与希腊阿尔戈利斯地区有关的
entries.en: The exhibition included photographs of Argolic coastal villages.
entries.zh: 展览中包括希腊阿尔戈利斯沿海村庄的照片。

entries.meaningZh: 船蛸属（学名 Argonauta）
entries.en: The index lists Argonauta under octopuses rather than under shelled bivalves.
entries.zh: 索引将船蛸属列在章鱼类之下，而不是列在有壳的双壳类之下。

entries.meaningZh: 银汞齐（天然银汞合金的旧矿物名称）
entries.en: The mineral label uses arguerite for a naturally occurring silver–mercury amalgam.
entries.zh: 矿物标签用arguerite这一旧名标示一种天然形成的银汞齐。

entries.meaningZh: 爱争论的人；争辩者（非正式）
entries.en: The old argufier challenged every suggestion made at the meeting.
entries.zh: 那个爱争论的老头对会上提出的每个建议都要质疑一番。

entries.meaningZh: 论据质量（此处用说服心理学义：论据使人对态度对象产生正面评价的程度）
entries.en: The experiment varied argument quality while keeping the speaker and message length constant.
entries.zh: 该实验改变了论据质量，同时保持说话者和信息长度不变。

entries.meaningZh: 论证；为支持某一观点而连贯组织的理由、陈述或事实
entries.en: Her argumentum moves from the cost of repairs to the need for a permanent maintenance fund.
entries.zh: 她的论证从维修费用谈起，进而说明设立长期维修基金的必要性。

entries.meaningZh: 敏锐地；机敏地（罕见用语）
entries.en: She argutely noticed that the two witnesses had described different doors.
entries.zh: 她敏锐地注意到，两名证人描述的是不同的门。

entries.meaningZh: 敏锐；机敏（罕见用语）
entries.en: His arguteness helped him spot the contradiction before the debate began.
entries.zh: 他的敏锐让他在辩论开始前就发现了那个矛盾。

entries.meaningZh: 螺状硫银矿（acanthite）的旧称；一种硫化银矿物
entries.en: The silver in this ore occurs mainly as argyrose, an old name for acanthite.
entries.zh: 这种矿石中的银主要以螺状硫银矿的形式存在，该矿物旧称argyrose。

entries.meaningZh: 深红银矿（pyrargyrite）的旧称；一种硫锑银矿物
entries.en: The collector's nineteenth-century catalogue uses argyrythrose for the mineral now called pyrargyrite.
entries.zh: 这位收藏家的十九世纪目录用argyrythrose称呼如今叫作深红银矿的矿物。

entries.meaningZh: 阿罗汉果位；成为阿罗汉的境界（佛教）
entries.en: The lecture discussed arhatship as a spiritual attainment rather than a hereditary title.
entries.zh: 讲座把阿罗汉果位作为一种修行成就来讨论，而非世袭头衔。

entries.meaningZh: 无流性；地表径流少且缺乏有组织水系的状态（水文学罕见用语）
entries.en: The geographer described the sandy plain's arheism, noting the absence of an organized drainage network.
entries.zh: 地理学家描述了这片沙质平原的无流性，指出那里缺乏有组织的排水水系。

entries.meaningZh: 阿里乌派信徒；持阿里乌主义者（基督教史）
entries.en: The theologian's critics called him an Arianist because of his account of Christ's divinity.
entries.zh: 由于他对基督神性的解释，这位神学家被批评者称为阿里乌派信徒。

entries.meaningZh: 腘动脉（拉丁解剖名称，英语为 popliteal artery）
entries.en: Arteria poplitea is printed beside the artery at the back of the knee in the atlas.
entries.zh: 那本图谱在膝后方的动脉旁印有 arteria poplitea，即腘动脉。

entries.meaningZh: 锁骨下动脉（拉丁解剖名称）
entries.en: The student translated arteria subclavia as subclavian artery in her notes.
entries.zh: 那个学生在笔记中把 arteria subclavia 译为 subclavian artery，即锁骨下动脉。

entries.meaningZh: 马蹄莲（Zantedeschia aethiopica，亦称白花海芋）
entries.en: A single arum lily stood in a narrow glass vase.
entries.zh: 一枝马蹄莲插在一个狭窄的玻璃花瓶里。

entries.meaningZh: 屏障避孕法（如使用避孕套）
entries.en: The leaflet describes condoms as a barrier method of contraception.
entries.zh: 这份宣传页将使用避孕套描述为一种屏障避孕法。

entries.meaningZh: 桦木风味汽水（本例为不含酒精的软饮料，不是啤酒）
entries.en: He ordered a birch beer instead of an alcoholic drink.
entries.zh: 他没有点酒，而是要了一杯桦木风味汽水。

entries.meaningZh: 双性恋者；会对不止一种性别的人产生情感或性吸引的人（不指身体性征）
entries.en: The interviewee described herself as a bisexual person, correcting the reporter's assumption that she was straight.
entries.zh: 受访者说自己是一名双性恋者，纠正了记者以为她是异性恋的假设。

entries.meaningZh: 每英寸比特数；线性记录密度单位（不是每平方英寸）
entries.en: The specification gives the recording density in bits per inch rather than bits per square inch.
entries.zh: 规格说明用每英寸比特数而不是每平方英寸比特数表示记录密度。

entries.meaningZh: 烟煤（煤的一种，不泛指未经加工的原煤）
entries.en: The geologist compared a sample of bituminous coal with a piece of lignite.
entries.zh: 地质学家将一块烟煤样品与一块褐煤作比较。

entries.meaningZh: 黑猫（本例为普通动物，不指软件名称）
entries.en: A black cat slipped through the garden gate ahead of us.
entries.zh: 一只黑猫先于我们溜过了花园门。

entries.meaningZh: 黑橄榄（本例为食用果实，不指其他同名树种）
entries.en: She removed the stone from a black olive before adding it to the salad.
entries.zh: 她先去掉一颗黑橄榄的核，再把它加进沙拉。

entries.meaningZh: 加勒比海一带的蜑螺Nerita peloronta；壳口有红色齿状突起
entries.en: She turned the bleeding tooth shell to show the red markings around its opening.
entries.zh: 她把Nerita peloronta的螺壳转过来，让我们看壳口周围的红色斑痕。

entries.meaningZh: 视线受阻、无法看清前方来车的弯道（不一定是急弯）
entries.en: A cyclist appeared from the blind bend just as the bus slowed down.
entries.zh: 公交车刚减速，一名骑车人便从那处视线受阻的弯道转了出来。

entries.meaningZh: 正体大写字母（书写义，不指建筑柱头）
entries.en: I wrote the first letter as a block capital and the rest in lower case.
entries.zh: 我把首字母写成正体大写字母，其余字母用小写。

entries.meaningZh: 整笔拨款；美国联邦拨给州或地方、用于宽泛指定领域的补助资金
entries.en: The state used part of the block grant to extend the community centre's opening hours.
entries.zh: 该州用整笔拨款中的一部分资金延长了社区中心的开放时间。

entries.meaningZh: 血常规检查；本例取全血细胞计数（CBC）义
entries.en: The blood profile showed that her platelet count had fallen since the previous test.
entries.zh: 这次血常规检查显示，她的血小板计数较上次检查下降了。

entries.meaningZh: 吹风煤气；发生炉在吹风阶段排出的气体
entries.en: A separate duct carried the blowing gas away from the generator.
entries.zh: 一条独立管道把吹风煤气从发生炉引走。

entries.meaningZh: 异戊巴比妥钠的俚称（巴比妥类药物名称）
entries.en: The glossary explained that blue angel was a slang name for amobarbital sodium.
entries.zh: 词汇表解释说，blue angel是异戊巴比妥钠的俚称。

entries.meaningZh: 北美鹰类Cooper's hawk的俗名（旧录学名Accipiter cooperii）
entries.en: The blue darter swept low across the clearing and disappeared among the trees.
entries.zh: 那只Cooper's hawk低低掠过林中空地，消失在树丛间。

entries.meaningZh: 蓝蓟（Echium vulgare）的俗名；一种有刺、开蓝花的植物（本例取该义）
entries.en: She wore thick gloves while clearing blue devil from the overgrown border.
entries.zh: 她戴着厚手套，清理杂草丛生的花境里的蓝蓟。

entries.meaningZh: 大声叫嚷、强烈抗议（口语，常用于 scream blue murder，不是谋杀）
entries.en: The neighbours screamed blue murder when the roadworks began at dawn.
entries.zh: 道路施工天一亮就开始了，邻居们为此大声抗议。

entries.meaningZh: 蓝调音；在蓝调或爵士乐中略降音高的音（不是简单指悲伤的音符）
entries.en: The singer lingered on a blue note before returning to the melody.
entries.zh: 歌手在一个蓝调音上停留片刻，然后回到主旋律。

entries.meaningZh: 蓝花万代兰（Vanda coerulea）；本例取该兰花物种义
entries.en: The grower moved the blue orchid closer so we could examine its large, flat flowers.
entries.zh: 种植者把蓝花万代兰移近，让我们仔细看它宽大而扁平的花朵。

entries.meaningZh: 蝶豆（Clitoria ternatea）；一种攀援豆科植物（本例取开蓝花的植物义）
entries.en: A blue pea vine climbed the fence beside our kitchen window.
entries.zh: 厨房窗边，一株蝶豆藤攀上了篱笆。

entries.meaningZh: 蓝色梭鲈；五大湖历史渔业所称的blue walleye类群
entries.en: The museum label identified the preserved fish as a blue pickerel from the old Lake Erie fishery.
entries.zh: 博物馆标签把这条保存下来的鱼标为旧时伊利湖渔业捕获的蓝色梭鲈。

entries.meaningZh: 蓝色梭鲈；blue walleye的历史渔业名称
entries.en: Family letters described catches of blue pike long before the fish disappeared from local markets.
entries.zh: 家书描写了捕捞蓝色梭鲈的情景，那还是这种鱼从当地市场上消失很久以前的事。

entries.meaningZh: 蓝点牡蛎；一种食用牡蛎的名称（本例取牡蛎义）
entries.en: A blue point lay open on a bed of ice beside the lemon wedges.
entries.zh: 一只蓝点牡蛎开壳放在冰上，旁边摆着柠檬角。

entries.meaningZh: 北美东南部开蓝花的植物Amsonia tabernaemontana（本例取植物义）
entries.en: Two clumps of blue star flowered beside the stone steps.
entries.zh: 石阶旁，两丛Amsonia tabernaemontana开着花。

entries.meaningZh: 蓝墙；警员为保护同僚而隐瞒真相的缄默惯例（比喻）
entries.en: The witness's testimony helped break the blue wall around the officers' misconduct.
entries.zh: 证人的证词有助于打破围绕那些警员不当行为形成的缄默屏障。

entries.meaningZh: 身体排泄物（生理学义，不是一般的物质损耗）
entries.en: The diagram shows how body waste leaves the digestive tract.
entries.zh: 示意图展示了身体排泄物如何离开消化道。

entries.meaningZh: 欧洲沼生植物Narthecium ossifragum；叶似草，开黄色小花
entries.en: Yellow bog asphodel flowers brightened the wet ground beyond the boardwalk.
entries.zh: 木栈道外的湿地上，Narthecium ossifragum的黄色小花显得格外明亮。

entries.meaningZh: 香杨梅（Myrica gale）；生于湿地的芳香灌木（本例取该植物义）
entries.en: The scent of bog myrtle rose from the wet bank as we brushed past its leaves.
entries.zh: 我们擦过香杨梅的叶子时，一股香气从潮湿的岸边飘起。

entries.meaningZh: 突然冲出、跑出（本例不指脱口说出）
entries.en: Why did he bolt out of the room without his coat?
entries.zh: 他为什么没穿外套就突然冲出了房间？

entries.meaningZh: 上流社交界；时髦人士群体（文学或旧式用语，本例为人群义）
entries.en: The novel's young musician is fascinated by the bon ton but uneasy at their parties.
entries.zh: 小说里的年轻乐师对上流社交界十分着迷，却在他们的聚会上感到不自在。

entries.meaningZh: 书蝎；拟蝎（蛛形纲动物，不是蛀书的昆虫或真正的蜘蛛）
entries.en: A tiny book scorpion moved between the loose sheets of the old volume.
entries.zh: 一只小书蝎在那部旧书松散的书页间爬动。

entries.meaningZh: “罗宋汤带”；美国卡茨基尔山区昔日以犹太人度假旅馆和演出文化闻名的地区（文化专名）
entries.en: The documentary uses old hotel menus to explore daily life in the Borscht Belt.
entries.zh: 纪录片利用旧旅馆菜单，探究“罗宋汤带”昔日的日常生活。

entries.meaningZh: 狗尾草（Setaria viridis）的俗名
entries.en: A tuft of bottle grass had taken root in the cracked pavement.
entries.zh: 一丛狗尾草在开裂的路面上扎了根。

entries.meaningZh: 昆士兰瓶树（Brachychiton rupestris）；具有膨大树干的澳大利亚乔木（本例取该种义）
entries.en: The bottle tree's swollen trunk made it easy to recognise beside the slender gums.
entries.zh: 纤细的桉树旁，那棵昆士兰瓶树膨大的树干让它很容易辨认。

entries.meaningZh: 北瓶鼻鲸（Hyperoodon ampullatus）
entries.en: The researcher recognised the bottle-nosed whale by its bulbous forehead as it surfaced.
entries.zh: 那头北瓶鼻鲸浮出水面时，研究员凭它鼓起的额头认出了它。

entries.meaningZh: 北瓶鼻鲸（Hyperoodon ampullatus）
entries.en: The survey map recorded where each bottlenose whale had been photographed in the North Atlantic.
entries.zh: 调查地图标出了在北大西洋拍到每一头北瓶鼻鲸的位置。

entries.meaningZh: 处于最底层、受人支配的人（比喻，不指底钩）
entries.en: The apprentice was tired of being treated as the bottom dog in the workshop.
entries.zh: 那个学徒厌倦了在作坊里被当作任人使唤的底层人物。

entries.meaningZh: 在水底觅食的动物或鱼（本例为生物义，不指投机者）
entries.en: The bottom feeder searched for food among the stones on the riverbed.
entries.zh: 那条底栖摄食鱼在河床的石块间寻找食物。

entries.meaningZh: 弹出；反弹出去（本例为球的运动，不指宣告出局）
entries.en: Why does the ball bounce out of the basket every time it hits the rim?
entries.zh: 为什么球每次撞到筐沿，都会从筐里弹出来？

entries.meaningZh: 与……紧密相连的（常用 bound up with，不是跳跃向上）
entries.en: Her sense of identity is bound up with the village where she grew up.
entries.zh: 她的自我认同感与她长大的那个村庄紧密相连。

entries.meaningZh: 弓弦麻纤维；从虎尾兰类植物取得、可制绳的强韧纤维（本例取纤维义）
entries.en: The museum displayed a coil of bowstring hemp beside the tools used to twist it into cord.
entries.zh: 博物馆把一卷弓弦麻纤维与将它捻成绳的工具陈列在一起。

entries.meaningZh: 短而宽松、从肩部自然垂下的箱形外套
entries.en: Her box coat hung loosely over the fitted dress she wore beneath it.
entries.zh: 她的箱形外套宽松地罩在里面那件合身连衣裙外。

entries.meaningZh: 博克斯埃尔德；美国南达科他州的一座城市（本例取此地名）
entries.en: We posted the parcel from Box Elder, South Dakota, before continuing our trip.
entries.zh: 我们在南达科他州的博克斯埃尔德寄出包裹后，继续赶路。

entries.meaningZh: 梅花扳手；闭口环形扳手（常写 box-end wrench，不是套筒扳手）
entries.en: He slipped the box-end wrench over the nut before trying to turn it.
entries.zh: 他先把梅花扳手套在螺母上，再尝试转动螺母。

entries.meaningZh: 梅花扳手；闭口扳手（美式用语，不是套筒扳手）
entries.en: The box wrench fitted the bolt head, but there was not enough room to swing the handle.
entries.zh: 那把梅花扳手能套住螺栓头，但没有足够的空间转动手柄。

entries.meaningZh: （英国口语）用于指极冷天气，常见于brass monkey weather一语
entries.en: It was brass monkey weather, and our breath hung in the air as we waited for the bus.
entries.zh: 天气冷得刺骨，我们等公交车时，呼出的气都在空中凝成白雾。

entries.meaningZh: 面包树（Artocarpus altilis）；结面包果的乔木
entries.en: The children rested beneath the breadfruit tree while their parents unpacked lunch.
entries.zh: 父母取出午餐时，孩子们在面包树下休息。

entries.meaningZh: 拆开即破、难以复原的防拆封口
entries.en: The jar's break seal split when Leo lifted the lid for the first time.
entries.zh: Leo第一次掀开罐盖时，罐子的防拆封口随之裂开。

entries.meaningZh: 游动时让鳍露出水面（本例取fin的同义动词义）
entries.en: From the pier, we watched a shark break water, its fin cutting a line through the surface.
entries.zh: 我们在码头上看着一条鲨鱼把鳍露出水面，鱼鳍划开一道水纹。

entries.meaningZh: 断电器触点；汽车分电器中接通或切断电流的电接点
entries.en: The mechanic examined a worn breaker point beneath the distributor cap.
entries.zh: 机械师检查了分电器盖下一个磨损的断电器触点。

entries.meaningZh: 乳房植入物；用于乳房重建或改变大小、形状的人工植入器械
entries.en: The surgeon showed her a sample breast implant while explaining the reconstruction options.
entries.zh: 外科医生说明乳房重建方案时，给她看了一个乳房植入物样品。

entries.meaningZh: 喘息时间；暂时休息或准备的间隙（本例不是工业干燥时间）
entries.en: The postponed deadline gave us a little breathing time to check the figures.
entries.zh: 截止日期推迟，给了我们一点喘息时间来核对数字。

entries.meaningZh: 中间联络员；在情报主管与秘密特工之间传递消息的人员（本例取情报工作义）
entries.en: The captured letter mentioned a bridge agent, but it gave no name for the courier.
entries.zh: 被截获的信中提到了一名中间联络员，却没有写出这位信使的姓名。

entries.meaningZh: 一手桥牌；桥牌玩家拿到的一手牌（本例不指台球手架）
entries.en: The bridge hand contained six hearts but no clubs.
entries.zh: 那手桥牌中有六张红桃，但没有梅花。

entries.meaningZh: 因……而表示不悦、愤慨（不是轻视某人）
entries.en: I knew she would bridle at the suggestion that her work was careless.
entries.zh: 我知道，暗示她工作粗心会让她感到不悦。

entries.meaningZh: 卤虫；生于盐水中的小型甲壳动物（本例取Artemia salina义）
entries.en: We transferred the brine shrimp to the larger tank with a fine-meshed net.
entries.zh: 我们用细网把卤虫转移到了更大的水槽里。

entries.meaningZh: 花序小穗下具长刚毛的禾草（本例取植物普通名词义）
entries.en: The bristle grass bent over the path, its long bristles catching the evening light.
entries.zh: 那丛长有刚毛的禾草弯向小路，长毛映着傍晚的光。

entries.meaningZh: 落基山刺果松（Pinus aristata）；本例取此种松树义
entries.en: The bristlecone pine gripped the rocky slope with roots exposed by the wind.
entries.zh: 那株落基山刺果松扎根于岩坡，部分树根被风吹得裸露出来。

entries.meaningZh: rapini叶菜；食用嫩叶、嫩梢和花蕾的芜菁类蔬菜
entries.en: She tossed the broccoli raab with garlic after briefly wilting its dark leaves.
entries.zh: 她先把rapini的深绿色叶片略微加热至变软，再与大蒜拌匀。

entries.meaningZh: 已经穿软、穿合脚的（本例为鞋，不指闯入）
entries.en: The boots were already broken in and felt comfortable from the first day.
entries.zh: 那双靴子已经穿软合脚，从第一天起穿着就很舒服。

entries.meaningZh: Brompton类型的紫罗兰（Matthiola incana）；花有香气的园艺植物
entries.en: The scent of Brompton stock drifted into the room through the open window at dusk.
entries.zh: 暮色中，Brompton类紫罗兰的香气从敞开的窗户飘进房间。

entries.meaningZh: 细茎、窄叶的禾草Agrostis canina的俗名（又称velvet bent）
entries.en: The brown bent formed a fine carpet around the edge of the lawn.
entries.zh: 草坪边缘，Agrostis canina长成了一层细密的草毯。

entries.meaningZh: 北美淡水鲶鱼Ameiurus nebulosus
entries.en: The brown bullhead stirred up a cloud of mud as it moved along the bottom.
entries.zh: 那条Ameiurus nebulosus沿水底游动时，搅起了一团泥沙。

entries.meaningZh: 褐化黄油；加热至乳固体变褐、产生坚果香气的黄油（不是烧黑的黄油）
entries.en: She tossed the cooked pasta in brown butter and scattered sage leaves over it.
entries.zh: 她把煮好的意面与褐化黄油拌匀，再在上面撒上鼠尾草叶。

entries.meaningZh: 灌木火灾；灌木或低矮植被燃烧的火（本例不是军事冲突）
entries.en: Smoke from a brush fire drifted across the empty road.
entries.zh: 一场灌木火灾的烟飘过空无一人的道路。

entries.meaningZh: 荒漠灌木Picrothamnus desertorum的俗名；旧称Artemisia spinescens
entries.en: The sheep cropped the low bud brush growing between the desert grasses.
entries.zh: 绵羊啃食着荒漠草丛之间低矮的Picrothamnus desertorum。

entries.meaningZh: 轻便马车用马鞭（本例不是汽车天线）
entries.en: A leather buggy whip hung beside the carriage in the museum display.
entries.zh: 博物馆展区里，一条皮制轻便马车鞭挂在马车旁。

entries.meaningZh: 外圆角；砖、台阶或其他构件边缘的圆弧形端面（本例取工程义）
entries.en: The shelf's bullnose felt smooth beneath my fingers.
entries.zh: 手指抚过搁板前端的圆弧边缘时，感觉很光滑。

entries.meaningZh: 烧痕；灼痕（本例为表面受热留下的痕迹，不限于陶瓷缺陷）
entries.en: The hot pan left a circular burn mark on the wooden counter.
entries.zh: 热锅在木制台面上留下了一圈烧痕。

entries.meaningZh: 公交线路（交通义，不指电气汇流线）
entries.en: The new bus line connects the railway station with the university.
entries.zh: 新公交线路连接火车站和大学。

entries.meaningZh: 从商经历；商业职业生涯（本例不是企业的存续寿命）
entries.en: Throughout her business life, she had avoided making promises she could not keep.
entries.zh: 在整个从商生涯中，她一直避免作出无法兑现的承诺。

entries.meaningZh: 商务套装；正式商务场合穿的西装套装（不是一般普通服装）
entries.en: He changed out of his business suit before taking the dog for a walk.
entries.zh: 他换下商务套装后，才带狗去散步。

entries.meaningZh: 包肉用的厚包装纸（不笼统保证所有品种都防水）
entries.en: The butcher wrapped the meat in butcher paper before putting it in a bag.
entries.zh: 肉贩先用厚包肉纸把肉包好，再放进袋子。

entries.meaningZh: 奶油南瓜；外形常呈梨状的南瓜品种（不是白胡桃泥汤）
entries.en: She peeled the butternut squash and cut it into cubes for roasting.
entries.zh: 她给奶油南瓜去皮，再切成方块准备烘烤。

entries.meaningZh: 一点一点地；缓慢地（本例为逐步前进，不指仅差几英寸获胜）
entries.en: The queue moved forward by inches, and we barely reached the door before closing time.
entries.zh: 队伍一点点地向前挪，我们差点没能在关门前到达门口。

entries.meaningZh: 软骨鱼；骨骼主要由软骨而非硬骨构成的鱼类个体
entries.en: The ray, a cartilaginous fish, lay half buried in the sandy bottom.
entries.zh: 那条鳐是一种软骨鱼，半埋在水底的沙中。

entries.meaningZh: 小熊猫（Ailurus fulgens）；本例取红褐色小熊猫义
entries.en: The cat bear curled its striped tail around its body as the evening cooled.
entries.zh: 傍晚天气转凉时，那只小熊猫把带条纹的尾巴盘在身边。

entries.meaningZh: 欧亚红松鼠（Sciurus vulgaris）；本例取该种义
entries.en: The cat squirrel's reddish coat stood out against the snow beneath the pines.
entries.zh: 松树下的白雪映衬出那只欧亚红松鼠红褐色的皮毛。

entries.meaningZh: Antennaria dioica；一种低矮、叶背有白毛的多年生草本
entries.en: Cat's foot formed a low mat along the edge of the rock garden.
entries.zh: Antennaria dioica在岩石花园边缘长成低矮的一片。

entries.meaningZh: 骶管麻醉；经骶裂孔进入骶管实施的硬膜外麻醉
entries.en: The anaesthetist explained the caudal anaesthesia and pointed out the sacral opening on a model.
entries.zh: 麻醉师讲解了骶管麻醉，并在模型上指出骶部的开口。

entries.meaningZh: Antrozous pallidus蝙蝠；又称pallid bat，本例取该种义
entries.en: A cave bat clung to a sheltered crevice just inside the entrance.
entries.zh: 一只Antrozous pallidus蝙蝠紧攀在洞口内侧一处避风的岩缝中。

entries.meaningZh: Hyalophora cecropia；北美的一种大型天蚕蛾
entries.en: The cecropia moth rested on the porch screen with its broad wings spread.
entries.zh: 那只Hyalophora cecropia天蚕蛾停在门廊纱网上，宽大的双翅展开着。

entries.meaningZh: 黄纬；天体在黄道以北或以南的角距离（本例取黄道坐标义）
entries.en: As the comet moved north of the ecliptic, its celestial latitude increased.
entries.zh: 随着彗星向黄道北侧移去，它的黄纬增大了。

entries.meaningZh: 黄经；以春分点为起点沿黄道向东量取的天体位置角（本例取黄道坐标义）
entries.en: Using the vernal equinox as zero, the astronomer marked the asteroid's celestial longitude on the ecliptic.
entries.zh: 天文学家以春分点为零点，在黄道上标出了那颗小行星的黄经。

entries.meaningZh: 定心钻头；带突出中心尖和两侧切削刃的木工钻头
entries.en: Fit the center bit into the brace before you start boring the hole.
entries.zh: 开始钻孔前，把定心钻头装到摇钻上。

entries.meaningZh: 都市圈的中心城市；本例指城市本身而非市中心城区
entries.en: The suburbs expanded, but the central city still held most of the region's major hospitals.
entries.zh: 郊区不断扩展，但该都市圈的大多数主要医院仍位于中心城市。

entries.meaningZh: 龙舌兰（Agave americana）；叶呈莲座状排列的多肉植物
entries.en: The century plant's spiny leaves spread across the dry gravel beside the steps.
entries.zh: 那株龙舌兰带刺的叶片，在台阶旁干燥的砾石地上向四周伸展。

entries.meaningZh: 香槟宾治；一种含香槟或其他起泡葡萄酒的混合饮料
entries.en: The host ladled champagne cup into small glasses while the musicians tuned their instruments.
entries.zh: 乐师们调音时，主人把香槟宾治舀进小玻璃杯里。

entries.meaningZh: 主矿脉；区别于分支矿脉的主要矿脉
entries.en: The old survey marked several narrow branches leading away from the champion lode.
entries.zh: 旧勘测图标出了从主矿脉分出的几条狭窄支脉。

entries.meaningZh: 斑点叉尾鮰（Ictalurus punctatus）；channel catfish的简称
entries.en: The angler released the channel cat gently after photographing its spotted flanks.
entries.zh: 钓鱼者拍下那条斑点叉尾鮰带斑点的体侧后，轻轻地把它放回了水中。

entries.meaningZh: 营房值班士兵；在正常办公时间以外处理本部队行政事务的士兵
entries.en: The charge of quarters recorded our arrival and directed us to the barracks office.
entries.zh: 营房值班士兵登记了我们的到达时间，并指引我们去营房办公室。

entries.meaningZh: 警方指控记录；记载某人被指控犯罪详情的正式文件
entries.en: The charge sheet listed the alleged offences beside the date and place of each incident.
entries.zh: 警方指控记录在每起事件的日期和地点旁，列出了涉嫌的罪行。

entries.meaningZh: 电荷单位；用来表示电荷量大小的计量单位
entries.en: The worksheet asks us to express the result in a charge unit such as the coulomb.
entries.zh: 练习单要求我们用库仑等电荷单位表示计算结果。

entries.meaningZh: 俄式奶油布丁；外圈有手指饼、内填奶油或卡仕达的冷甜点
entries.en: A ribbon around the charlotte russe kept the upright sponge fingers neatly in place.
entries.zh: 围在俄式奶油布丁外的一条缎带，把竖立的手指饼整齐地固定在原位。

entries.meaningZh: Betula lenta桦树；北美东部的一种桦树，又称sweet birch
entries.en: The cherry birch shaded a stone bench at the bend in the path.
entries.zh: 小径转弯处那株Betula lenta桦树，为一张石凳遮出了阴凉。

entries.meaningZh: 普通浮萍；一种小型漂浮水生植物（Lemna minor）
entries.en: A thin mat of common duckweed covered the still water beneath the bridge.
entries.zh: 桥下平静的水面上覆盖着薄薄一层普通浮萍。

entries.meaningZh: 常见毛病；经常出现的错误（本例不是地质学中的断层义）
entries.en: Holding the camera at an angle is a common fault in these early photographs.
entries.zh: 在这些早期照片中，把相机拿歪是一个常见毛病。

entries.meaningZh: 灯心草（Juncus effusus，一种湿地植物）
entries.en: Clumps of common rush grew along the damp edge of the pond.
entries.zh: 池塘潮湿的边缘长着一丛丛灯心草。

entries.meaningZh: 药用鼠尾草；常用作香草的鼠尾草（Salvia officinalis）
entries.en: She planted common sage in a sunny corner beside the kitchen door.
entries.zh: 她在厨房门旁一个向阳的角落种了药用鼠尾草。

entries.meaningZh: 圣餐桌；基督教礼拜中供举行圣餐使用的桌子
entries.en: A white cloth covered the communion table at the front of the chapel.
entries.zh: 小教堂前方的圣餐桌上盖着一块白布。

entries.meaningZh: 络石；星茉莉（Trachelospermum jasminoides，并非茉莉属植物）
entries.en: The confederate jasmine had climbed well above the garden gate.
entries.zh: 那株络石已经攀爬到远高于花园门的地方。

entries.meaningZh: 康加舞队列；前后相接、排成一列的康加舞者
entries.en: By the end of the party, the conga line stretched from the kitchen to the garden.
entries.zh: 聚会快结束时，跳康加舞的队列从厨房一直排到了花园。

entries.meaningZh: 彩色手工纸；常用于剪贴制作的厚纸
entries.en: The children cut paper lanterns from sheets of red construction paper.
entries.zh: 孩子们用一张张红色手工纸剪出了纸灯笼。

entries.meaningZh: 以好争辩的方式；争论不休地
entries.en: He responded contentiously to every suggestion, turning a brief meeting into a long argument.
entries.zh: 他对每个建议都争辩不休，把一次简短会议变成了长时间的争论。

entries.meaningZh: 食用油；烹调用油
entries.en: A little cooking oil had leaked onto the shelf beneath the bottle.
entries.zh: 少量食用油漏到了瓶子下面的架子上。

entries.meaningZh: 文字编辑；对文稿的语法、用字及格式等进行校订
entries.en: Careful copy editing removed several inconsistent spellings from the report.
entries.zh: 细致的文字编辑消除了报告中几处拼写不一致的问题。

entries.meaningZh: 红酒炖鸡；用葡萄酒炖制的法式鸡肉菜肴
entries.en: He ordered coq au vin and used a piece of bread to soak up the sauce.
entries.zh: 他点了红酒炖鸡，并用一块面包蘸取酱汁。

entries.meaningZh: 取芯钻头；切出环形孔、使中间芯样保留下来的钻头
entries.en: The geologist fitted a fresh core bit before collecting the next rock sample.
entries.zh: 地质学家在采集下一份岩样前装上了一个新的取芯钻头。

entries.meaningZh: 咸牛肉土豆杂烩；用切碎的咸牛肉和土豆等制成的菜肴
entries.en: He fried the corned beef hash until a crisp crust formed underneath.
entries.zh: 他把咸牛肉土豆杂烩煎至底部形成一层酥脆的外皮。

entries.meaningZh: 波纹铁皮；瓦楞铁板（常用于屋顶或墙面）
entries.en: Rain drummed loudly on the corrugated iron above the shed.
entries.zh: 雨点敲打着棚顶的波纹铁皮，发出很大的声响。

entries.meaningZh: 上诉法院；负责审查下级法院裁判的法院
entries.en: In the legal drama, the court of appeals orders a new trial.
entries.zh: 那部法律剧中，上诉法院下令重新审判。

entries.meaningZh: 覆盖材料；用来覆盖表面的材料（本例为建筑材料）
entries.en: The architect chose a lighter covering material for the curved roof.
entries.zh: 建筑师为弧形屋顶选择了较轻的覆盖材料。

entries.meaningZh: 大蚊；长脚蚊状的双翅目昆虫（不是盲蛛）
entries.en: A crane fly rested on the outside of the window, its long legs spread wide.
entries.zh: 一只大蚊停在窗外，细长的腿向四周展开。

entries.meaningZh: 爬进去；钻进被窝（本例为进入床铺的动作）
entries.en: She lifted the duvet so the child could crawl in beside her.
entries.zh: 她掀起被子，让孩子能钻进被窝睡在她身旁。

entries.meaningZh: 信贷申请；申请获得贷款或赊购额度的文件
entries.en: The bank returned the credit application because the income section was blank.
entries.zh: 银行退回了那份信贷申请，因为收入一栏没有填写。

entries.meaningZh: 逐渐出现；不知不觉地混入
entries.en: Small errors can creep in when figures are copied by hand.
entries.zh: 手工抄写数字时，小错误可能不知不觉地混进来。

entries.meaningZh: 批判性分析；有依据地评估观点、方法或作品
entries.en: Her essay offers a critical analysis of the evidence rather than a summary of the argument.
entries.zh: 她的文章对证据作了批判性分析，而不只是概述论点。

entries.meaningZh: 切换到……画面（电影或电视剪辑用语）
entries.en: The director decided to cut to the empty platform before revealing the arriving train.
entries.zh: 导演决定先把画面切到空站台，再让驶来的火车出现在镜头中。

entries.meaningZh: 与格；常用于标记间接宾语等的语法格
entries.en: The teacher highlighted dem Kind to show the dative case in the German sentence.
entries.zh: 老师标出了 dem Kind，以展示那个德语句子中的与格。

entries.meaningZh: 死喻；因长期使用而不再让人明显感到比喻性的表达
entries.en: Calling the lower part of a hill its foot is a familiar example of a dead metaphor.
entries.zh: 把山的下部称为山脚，是死喻的一个常见例子。

entries.meaningZh: 汽车驾驶员旁的乘客座位（美式及澳式俚语）
entries.en: The narrator refuses the death seat and climbs into the back of the car.
entries.zh: 叙述者不肯坐副驾驶座，而是爬进了汽车后排。

entries.meaningZh: 深水涉渡；车辆等通过较深水域的行动
entries.en: The vehicle's seals were inspected before the deep fording trial.
entries.zh: 深水涉渡试验前，检查人员检查了那辆车的密封装置。

entries.meaningZh: 国防计划；有关国防工作的规划或项目
entries.en: The historian devoted a chapter to the country's post-war defence program.
entries.zh: 历史学家用一章篇幅介绍了该国战后的国防计划。

entries.meaningZh: 银行保险箱；存放贵重物品的保管箱
entries.en: The antique ring stayed in a deposit box at the bank while the house was being renovated.
entries.zh: 房屋翻修期间，那枚古董戒指一直存放在银行保险箱里。

entries.meaningZh: 值班警官；在警局负责接待及相关事务的警官（本例为警务义）
entries.en: The desk officer asked me to fill in a form before I spoke to a detective.
entries.zh: 在我与侦探交谈前，值班警官让我先填一张表格。

entries.meaningZh: 拘禁营；集中拘留人员的营地
entries.en: The documentary follows letters sent from a detention camp to the prisoners' families.
entries.zh: 那部纪录片围绕从拘禁营寄给被拘禁者家属的信件展开。

entries.meaningZh: 方言地图集；展示方言特征地域分布的地图汇编
entries.en: The dialect atlas shows where speakers use different names for the same tool.
entries.zh: 那本方言地图集展示了哪些地区的说话者会用不同名称称呼同一种工具。

entries.meaningZh: 方言地理学；研究方言特征地域分布的学科
entries.en: Her research in dialect geography compares vowel patterns across neighbouring valleys.
entries.zh: 她的方言地理学研究比较了相邻山谷之间的元音模式。

entries.meaningZh: 数字录音带（DAT）；用于数字音频记录的磁带
entries.en: The technician transferred the concert from digital audiotape to the archive server.
entries.zh: 技术员把那场音乐会的录音从数字录音带转存到了档案服务器。

entries.meaningZh: 直邮广告；直接邮寄给潜在顾客等的宣传邮件（本例指邮件本身）
entries.en: A colourful direct mailer offered me a discount on my first order.
entries.zh: 一份色彩鲜艳的直邮广告给了我首次下单的折扣。

entries.meaningZh: 析取连词；表示选择关系的连词
entries.en: The word or functions as a disjunctive conjunction in 'You can walk or take the bus'.
entries.zh: 在 You can walk or take the bus 这句话中，or 用作表示选择关系的析取连词。

entries.meaningZh: 狗屋；供狗栖息的户外小屋
entries.en: The dog house stood under the tree, away from the afternoon sun.
entries.zh: 狗屋放在树下，避开午后的阳光。

entries.meaningZh: 完蛋了的；无望脱困的（非正式）
entries.en: Without a spare battery, we were done for when the torch went out.
entries.zh: 手电筒一灭，我们没有备用电池，真是束手无策了。

entries.meaningZh: 双小节线；乐谱中由两条竖线构成的标记
entries.en: The pianist paused at the double bar before beginning the next section.
entries.zh: 钢琴演奏者在双小节线处稍作停顿，然后开始下一部分。

entries.meaningZh: 双簧；两片相对振动的簧片组成的吹奏部件
entries.en: The oboe's double reed was stored in a small protective case.
entries.zh: 双簧管的双簧被收在一个小保护盒里。

entries.meaningZh: 双排扣西装套装（不只指上衣）
entries.en: He collected his double-breasted suit from the tailor the day before the wedding.
entries.zh: 婚礼前一天，他从裁缝那里取回了自己的双排扣西装套装。

entries.meaningZh: 将……处以肢解酷刑（历史用语）
entries.en: In the historical drama, the judge threatens to draw and quarter the rebel.
entries.zh: 那部历史剧中，法官威胁要将叛乱者处以肢解酷刑。

entries.meaningZh: 融化黄油（常作酱汁；也可特指澄清黄油）
entries.en: The restaurant served the lobster with a small dish of drawn butter.
entries.zh: 餐馆给龙虾配了一小碟融化黄油。

entries.meaningZh: 把……喝下；喝光
entries.en: She paused to drink down the last of her water before continuing the climb.
entries.zh: 她停下来喝光了剩下的水，然后继续攀登。

entries.meaningZh: 中途被放弃；逐渐遭到淘汰
entries.en: Several early ideas will drop by the wayside as the design becomes clearer.
entries.zh: 随着设计逐渐明确，几个早期构想会被放弃。

entries.meaningZh: 放短球；轻吊近网球（本例为网球）
entries.en: Her drop shot landed just over the net, beyond the reach of the approaching player.
entries.zh: 她的短球刚好落在网的另一侧，赶上来的球员没能碰到。

entries.meaningZh: 疏忽失误；把应当处理好的事搞砸（非正式）
entries.en: We must not drop the ball now that the customer has finally agreed to a meeting.
entries.zh: 客户好不容易同意见面，我们现在可不能疏忽失误。

entries.meaningZh: 防尘外衣；工作时为防灰尘而穿的罩衣
entries.en: She hung her dust coat by the workshop door before going into the house.
entries.zh: 她进屋前把防尘罩衣挂在了工作室门边。

entries.meaningZh: 书籍护封；包在书籍封面外可取下的纸封套
entries.en: The dust wrapper was torn, but the cloth binding underneath was still clean.
entries.zh: 书的护封破了，但下面的布面装帧仍很干净。

entries.meaningZh: 耳科专科医生
entries.en: The ear specialist asked the receptionist to bring in the next patient.
entries.zh: 耳科专科医生请接待员带下一位患者进来。

entries.meaningZh: 东侧；东面（不是纽约某类街区的专称）
entries.en: A narrow footpath runs along the east side of the lake.
entries.zh: 一条狭窄的步行小路沿着湖的东侧延伸。

entries.meaningZh: 餐馆；供人用餐的场所
entries.en: We found a quiet eating place down a side street near the station.
entries.zh: 我们在车站附近一条小街里找到了一家安静的餐馆。

entries.meaningZh: 蛋奶汽水；以牛奶、糖浆和苏打水调制的饮品（通常不含鸡蛋）
entries.en: The counter served an egg cream in a tall glass with a striped straw.
entries.zh: 柜台送来一杯装在高玻璃杯里的蛋奶汽水，杯中插着一根条纹吸管。

entries.meaningZh: 蛋花汤；将蛋液倒入热汤中形成蛋花的汤
entries.en: She stirred the eggdrop soup gently before bringing the bowls to the table.
entries.zh: 她轻轻搅了搅蛋花汤，再把汤碗端上桌。

entries.meaningZh: 选举委员会；负责组织或监督选举的机构
entries.en: The election commission published a map of the polling stations.
entries.zh: 选举委员会公布了一张投票站分布图。

entries.meaningZh: 电费账单（不是泛指电子账单）
entries.en: Our electric bill fell after we replaced the old freezer.
entries.zh: 换掉旧冰柜后，我们的电费账单金额降低了。

entries.meaningZh: 导电；电流通过物质的过程（区别于电导这一量）
entries.en: The science lesson compared electrical conduction in copper and in glass.
entries.zh: 那节科学课比较了铜和玻璃的导电情况。

entries.meaningZh: 电梯井；供电梯升降的竖井
entries.en: The builders left space for an elevator shaft beside the central staircase.
entries.zh: 建筑工人在中央楼梯旁留出了建造电梯井的空间。

entries.meaningZh: 与家人一起；在亲近的家人般的氛围中
entries.en: They preferred to dine en famille rather than join the formal banquet.
entries.zh: 他们宁愿与家人一起吃饭，也不愿参加正式宴会。

entries.meaningZh: 爆炸装置（区别于仅负责触发的引爆装置）
entries.en: The station remained closed until specialists had removed the explosive device.
entries.zh: 直到专业人员移走那个爆炸装置，车站才解除封闭。

entries.meaningZh: 外置驱动器；连接在计算机外部的存储设备
entries.en: She unplugged the external drive only after the backup had finished.
entries.zh: 备份完成后，她才拔下外置驱动器。

entries.meaningZh: 遮光眼罩；睡眠时用来遮挡光线的眼罩（本例不是护肤眼膜）
entries.en: The bright cabin lights made me glad I had packed an eye mask.
entries.zh: 机舱里明亮的灯光让我庆幸自己带了遮光眼罩。

entries.meaningZh: 保全面子的办法或举动；使人免于难堪的事物
entries.en: The unexpected train delay was a face saver for the host, who had forgotten to book a room.
entries.zh: 那次意外的火车延误给忘了订房的主人保全了面子。

entries.meaningZh: 保全面子；避免失去尊严或陷入难堪的行为
entries.en: Face saving mattered more to the rival managers than solving the problem.
entries.zh: 对那两位相互竞争的经理来说，保全面子比解决问题更重要。

entries.meaningZh: 提取公因子（本例为数学用法）
entries.en: You can factor out three from both terms before simplifying the expression.
entries.zh: 化简这个表达式前，你可以从两项中提取公因子三。

entries.meaningZh: 无法回避的生活现实（常指令人不快但不得不接受的事）
entries.en: Delays and cancelled plans are facts of life when you travel in winter.
entries.zh: 冬天旅行时，延误和计划取消是无法回避的现实。

entries.meaningZh: 粪便；排出的固体消化废物（不包括尿液）
entries.en: The lab used separate containers for urine and faecal matter.
entries.zh: 实验室用不同的容器分别盛放尿液和粪便。

entries.meaningZh: 转售限价协议；制造商与零售商约定品牌产品最低售价的协议（历史商业用语）
entries.en: The historian compared the old fair-trade agreement with the shop's price lists from the same decade.
entries.zh: 历史学家把那份旧式转售限价协议与商店同一年代的价目表作了比较。
